meta.title: Bloody Battle
meta.description: All of Magrasea shall judge your misdeeds.

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: The multiple layers of barriers are as paper to Eosphorus, easily shredded by his attacks. They pierce through the sword held up in defense and the wound-riddled body that they are defending.
units.displayText: The multiple layers of barriers are as paper to Eosphorus, easily shredded by his attacks. They pierce through the sword held up in defense and the wound-riddled body that they are defending.

spans.text: The multiple layers of barriers are as paper to Eosphorus, easily shredded by his attacks. They pierce through the sword held up in defense and the wound-riddled body that they are defending.

units.rawText: Hrg!
units.displayText: Hrg!

spans.text: Hrg!

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: ...Stay back, Professor!
units.displayText: ...Stay back, Professor!

spans.text: ...Stay back, Professor!

units.rawText: The girl's sword trembles; it is the only thing that's keeping her standing. Despite that, she still attempts to shelter my body behind her frail frame.
units.displayText: The girl's sword trembles; it is the only thing that's keeping her standing. Despite that, she still attempts to shelter my body behind her frail frame.

spans.text: The girl's sword trembles; it is the only thing that's keeping her standing. Despite that, she still attempts to shelter my body behind her frail frame.

units.rawText: ...I can still fight. Trust me, Professor...
units.displayText: ...I can still fight. Trust me, Professor...

spans.text: ...I can still fight. Trust me, Professor...

units.rawText: Just focus on your work! Leave this to me!
units.displayText: Just focus on your work! Leave this to me!

spans.text: Just focus on your work! Leave this to me!

units.rawText: Persicaria musters all her strength and swings; after the explosion, the ground is weak enough that her slash goes clean through it.
units.displayText: Persicaria musters all her strength and swings; after the explosion, the ground is weak enough that her slash goes clean through it.

spans.text: Persicaria musters all her strength and swings; after the explosion, the ground is weak enough that her slash goes clean through it.

units.rawText: The patches of ground we're on are drawn apart by the passage's gravity and I can only watch as she floats away, fragile and alone.
units.displayText: The patches of ground we're on are drawn apart by the passage's gravity and I can only watch as she floats away, fragile and alone.

spans.text: The patches of ground we're on are drawn apart by the passage's gravity and I can only watch as she floats away, fragile and alone.

units.rawText: I understand. I'll seize the opportunity you make for me, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I understand. I'll seize the opportunity you make for me, Persicaria.

spans.text: I understand. I'll seize the opportunity you make for me, Persicaria.

units.rawText: As she watches the person precious to her leave the battlefield, Persicaria takes a deep breath and looks at the figure before her again.
units.displayText: As she watches the person precious to her leave the battlefield, Persicaria takes a deep breath and looks at the figure before her again.

spans.text: As she watches the person precious to her leave the battlefield, Persicaria takes a deep breath and looks at the figure before her again.

units.rawText: Worried about <cmdr> to the very end? I do envy them. Every single one of them, throwing their lives away for the insubstantial future they describe...
units.displayText: Worried about {교수} to the very end? I do envy them. Every single one of them, throwing their lives away for the insubstantial future they describe...

spans.text: Worried about
to the very end? I do envy them. Every single one of them, throwing their lives away for the insubstantial future they describe...

units.rawText: However... that is all.
units.displayText: However... that is all.

spans.text: However... that is all.

units.rawText: Several rays of lightning-fast operands lance through Persicaria's body.
units.displayText: Several rays of lightning-fast operands lance through Persicaria's body.

spans.text: Several rays of lightning-fast operands lance through Persicaria's body.

units.rawText: Gwooh...
units.displayText: Gwooh...

spans.text: Gwooh...

units.rawText: Blood-red operands drip from her wounds. Her mind is hazy, but she adamantly refuses to fall.
units.displayText: Blood-red operands drip from her wounds. Her mind is hazy, but she adamantly refuses to fall.

spans.text: Blood-red operands drip from her wounds. Her mind is hazy, but she adamantly refuses to fall.

units.rawText: I'll ask you one last time, Persicaria. Hand over the authorizations.
units.displayText: I'll ask you one last time, Persicaria. Hand over the authorizations.

spans.text: I'll ask you one last time, Persicaria. Hand over the authorizations.

units.rawText: The hollow world made by the gods does not deserve to be cherished. Only by altering its base layer logic can its course be corrected to what is right.
units.displayText: The hollow world made by the gods does not deserve to be cherished. Only by altering its base layer logic can its course be corrected to what is right.

spans.text: The hollow world made by the gods does not deserve to be cherished. Only by altering its base layer logic can its course be corrected to what is right.

units.rawText: Only then, when the new world is born, will you return to your true selves.
units.displayText: Only then, when the new world is born, will you return to your true selves.

spans.text: Only then, when the new world is born, will you return to your true selves.

units.rawText: There was a time where my heart was lost. There was a time where I was hesitant. There was a time where all I wanted to do was run away from my responsibilities.
units.displayText: There was a time where my heart was lost. There was a time where I was hesitant. There was a time where all I wanted to do was run away from my responsibilities.

spans.text: There was a time where my heart was lost. There was a time where I was hesitant. There was a time where all I wanted to do was run away from my responsibilities.

units.rawText: But after meeting <cmdr>, the fog cleared from my mind.
units.displayText: But after meeting {교수}, the fog cleared from my mind.

spans.text: But after meeting
, the fog cleared from my mind.

units.rawText: It is because I met the Professor and everyone in Magrasea that I have become Persicaria of the Oasis, become the me that I am now.
units.displayText: It is because I met the Professor and everyone in Magrasea that I have become Persicaria of the Oasis, become the me that I am now.

spans.text: It is because I met the Professor and everyone in Magrasea that I have become Persicaria of the Oasis, become the me that I am now.

units.rawText: And that is why I will not allow you to destroy all this, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: And that is why I will not allow you to destroy all this, Eosphorus.

spans.text: And that is why I will not allow you to destroy all this, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: ...What a disappointing answer.
units.displayText: ...What a disappointing answer.

spans.text: ...What a disappointing answer.

units.rawText: If it is a battle you wish, then a battle you shall have.
units.displayText: If it is a battle you wish, then a battle you shall have.

spans.text: If it is a battle you wish, then a battle you shall have.

units.rawText: Meteor fragments and razor-sharp rays pierce Persicaria's body one after another.
units.displayText: Meteor fragments and razor-sharp rays pierce Persicaria's body one after another.

spans.text: Meteor fragments and razor-sharp rays pierce Persicaria's body one after another.

units.rawText: ...Ugh.
units.displayText: ...Ugh.

spans.text: ...Ugh.

units.rawText: It burns to breathe, indicating that her frame is close to its limits.
units.displayText: It burns to breathe, indicating that her frame is close to its limits.

spans.text: It burns to breathe, indicating that her frame is close to its limits.

units.rawText: She forces herself to look up, trying to tell where the enemy is through her blood-dimmed vision.
units.displayText: She forces herself to look up, trying to tell where the enemy is through her blood-dimmed vision.

spans.text: She forces herself to look up, trying to tell where the enemy is through her blood-dimmed vision.

units.rawText: Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations.
units.displayText: Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations.

spans.text: Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations.

units.rawText: Impelled by operands, the broken shards of her sword impale Persicaria through her chest, and before she can pull them out, a dazzling ray of starlight follows behind them...
units.displayText: Impelled by operands, the broken shards of her sword impale Persicaria through her chest, and before she can pull them out, a dazzling ray of starlight follows behind them...

spans.text: Impelled by operands, the broken shards of her sword impale Persicaria through her chest, and before she can pull them out, a dazzling ray of starlight follows behind them...

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: The stellar radiance that pierces her body is dyed crimson.
units.displayText: The stellar radiance that pierces her body is dyed crimson.

spans.text: The stellar radiance that pierces her body is dyed crimson.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I will admit that you are very stubborn.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I will admit that you are very stubborn.

spans.text: Persicaria, I will admit that you are very stubborn.

units.rawText: But... What if I do this?
units.displayText: But... What if I do this?

spans.text: But... What if I do this?

units.rawText: His merciless assault pierces her shields and stabs through her left arm.
units.displayText: His merciless assault pierces her shields and stabs through her left arm.

spans.text: His merciless assault pierces her shields and stabs through her left arm.

units.rawText: Or this?
units.displayText: Or this?

spans.text: Or this?

units.rawText: <color=red>...Her right leg.</color>
units.displayText: ...Her right leg.

spans.text: ...Her right leg.

units.rawText: Will you yield now?
units.displayText: Will you yield now?

spans.text: Will you yield now?

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: <color=red>...Her right arm.</color>
units.displayText: ...Her right arm.

spans.text: ...Her right arm.

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: <color=red>...Her wrists.</color>
units.displayText: ...Her wrists.

spans.text: ...Her wrists.

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: <color=red>...Her voicebox.</color>
units.displayText: ...Her voicebox.

spans.text: ...Her voicebox.

units.rawText: <color=red>...</color>
By the time the bloodstained radiance fades, the pink-haired Doll is riddled with holes.
units.displayText: By the time the bloodstained radiance fades, the pink-haired Doll is riddled with holes.

spans.text: By the time the bloodstained radiance fades, the pink-haired Doll is riddled with holes.

units.rawText: Her Entropized neural core is exposed to the world, so fragile that it looks as though it might scatter on the wind like its owner.
units.displayText: Her Entropized neural core is exposed to the world, so fragile that it looks as though it might scatter on the wind like its owner.

spans.text: Her Entropized neural core is exposed to the world, so fragile that it looks as though it might scatter on the wind like its owner.

units.rawText: Much as I would like to plumb the depths of your despair, you can't even speak anymore, can you?
units.displayText: Much as I would like to plumb the depths of your despair, you can't even speak anymore, can you?

spans.text: Much as I would like to plumb the depths of your despair, you can't even speak anymore, can you?

units.rawText: ...Are you still conscious? Your conviction will only bring you more suffering.
units.displayText: ...Are you still conscious? Your conviction will only bring you more suffering.

spans.text: ...Are you still conscious? Your conviction will only bring you more suffering.

units.rawText: Therefore—Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations and I will put an end to your pain.
units.displayText: Therefore—Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations and I will put an end to your pain.

spans.text: Therefore—Hand over the Entropic leader's authorizations and I will put an end to your pain.

units.rawText: <color=red>Nuh...</color>
units.displayText: Nuh...

spans.text: Nuh...

units.rawText: She slowly raises what is left of her right arm.
units.displayText: She slowly raises what is left of her right arm.

spans.text: She slowly raises what is left of her right arm.

units.rawText: Clasped in what few joints remain of her fingers are a fragment of a shattered blade.
units.displayText: Clasped in what few joints remain of her fingers are a fragment of a shattered blade.

spans.text: Clasped in what few joints remain of her fingers are a fragment of a shattered blade.

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea says no more. For the first time, he calls forth his spears of piercing starlight in anger, cutting through the fragmented blade and the hand that held it.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea says no more. For the first time, he calls forth his spears of piercing starlight in anger, cutting through the fragmented blade and the hand that held it.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea says no more. For the first time, he calls forth his spears of piercing starlight in anger, cutting through the fragmented blade and the hand that held it.

units.rawText: Do you wish to prove yourself a true martyr? Very well. I shall grant your wish.
units.displayText: Do you wish to prove yourself a true martyr? Very well. I shall grant your wish.

spans.text: Do you wish to prove yourself a true martyr? Very well. I shall grant your wish.

units.rawText: The starlight lifts up the fragmented blade and then it plunges deep into Persicaria's core.
units.displayText: The starlight lifts up the fragmented blade and then it plunges deep into Persicaria's core.

spans.text: The starlight lifts up the fragmented blade and then it plunges deep into Persicaria's core.

units.rawText: <color=red>...</color>
...This is the ending you sought. And now, it is time for me to pursue mine.
units.displayText: ...This is the ending you sought. And now, it is time for me to pursue mine.

spans.text: ...This is the ending you sought. And now, it is time for me to pursue mine.

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes burrow out of the ground to surround the new monarch of Magrasea.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes burrow out of the ground to surround the new monarch of Magrasea.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes burrow out of the ground to surround the new monarch of Magrasea.

units.rawText: Stop those two humans and that green-haired Doll, but do not kill them. The plan for rebirth requires them.
units.displayText: Stop those two humans and that green-haired Doll, but do not kill them. The plan for rebirth requires them.

spans.text: Stop those two humans and that green-haired Doll, but do not kill them. The plan for rebirth requires them.

units.rawText: <color=red>...</color>
...Entropics?
units.displayText: ...Entropics?

spans.text: ...Entropics?

units.rawText: They hiss and roar, but not in response to his commands.
units.displayText: They hiss and roar, but not in response to his commands.

spans.text: They hiss and roar, but not in response to his commands.

units.rawText: When Eosphorus turns, he sees that monsters he scorned crouching around the unrecognizable ruin of a frame, fawning and kneeling before it.
units.displayText: When Eosphorus turns, he sees that monsters he scorned crouching around the unrecognizable ruin of a frame, fawning and kneeling before it.

spans.text: When Eosphorus turns, he sees that monsters he scorned crouching around the unrecognizable ruin of a frame, fawning and kneeling before it.

units.rawText: Don't tell me...!
units.displayText: Don't tell me...!

spans.text: Don't tell me...!

units.rawText: He casts forth a star-piercing spear of glory, but the Entropics gather to block it with their bodies.
units.displayText: He casts forth a star-piercing spear of glory, but the Entropics gather to block it with their bodies.

spans.text: He casts forth a star-piercing spear of glory, but the Entropics gather to block it with their bodies.

units.rawText: Their collective wrath intensifies the breakdown of the very space around them. The king of Magrasea is compelled to portion out some of his neural cloud to stabilize his surroundings.
units.displayText: Their collective wrath intensifies the breakdown of the very space around them. The king of Magrasea is compelled to portion out some of his neural cloud to stabilize his surroundings.

spans.text: Their collective wrath intensifies the breakdown of the very space around them. The king of Magrasea is compelled to portion out some of his neural cloud to stabilize his surroundings.

units.rawText: Just as he tries to destroy everything before him with sheer might, that ruined, broken body suddenly blazes with the flame of life.
units.displayText: Just as he tries to destroy everything before him with sheer might, that ruined, broken body suddenly blazes with the flame of life.

spans.text: Just as he tries to destroy everything before him with sheer might, that ruined, broken body suddenly blazes with the flame of life.

units.rawText: <color=red>...</color>
<color=red>......</color>
<color=red>We...</color>
units.displayText: We...

spans.text: We...

units.rawText: <color=red>We're...</color>
units.displayText: We're...

spans.text: We're...

units.rawText: The agony of the flesh cannot hold back the immensity of her resolve. The tattered remains of a Doll rise shakily to its feet amidst the ruins.
units.displayText: The agony of the flesh cannot hold back the immensity of her resolve. The tattered remains of a Doll rise shakily to its feet amidst the ruins.

spans.text: The agony of the flesh cannot hold back the immensity of her resolve. The tattered remains of a Doll rise shakily to its feet amidst the ruins.

units.rawText: <color=red>We're... not... FINISHED YET...!</color>
units.displayText: We're... not... FINISHED YET...!

spans.text: We're... not... FINISHED YET...!

units.rawText: ...Impossible!
units.displayText: ...Impossible!

spans.text: ...Impossible!

units.rawText: For the first time in a long time, Magrasea's king feels the thrill of terror in his heart as he looks at the ruined body in front of him. He tries to crush her conviction with summoned meteors, but the Entropics and her shields block them all.
units.displayText: For the first time in a long time, Magrasea's king feels the thrill of terror in his heart as he looks at the ruined body in front of him. He tries to crush her conviction with summoned meteors, but the Entropics and her shields block them all.

spans.text: For the first time in a long time, Magrasea's king feels the thrill of terror in his heart as he looks at the ruined body in front of him. He tries to crush her conviction with summoned meteors, but the Entropics and her shields block them all.

units.rawText: Under their protection, her exposed core slowly begins knitting together and restoring itself by the power of the Entropy.
units.displayText: Under their protection, her exposed core slowly begins knitting together and restoring itself by the power of the Entropy.

spans.text: Under their protection, her exposed core slowly begins knitting together and restoring itself by the power of the Entropy.

units.rawText: Purple operands condense on her shredded body, slowly repairing the damage done by the piercing shafts of starlight.
units.displayText: Purple operands condense on her shredded body, slowly repairing the damage done by the piercing shafts of starlight.

spans.text: Purple operands condense on her shredded body, slowly repairing the damage done by the piercing shafts of starlight.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>GRRRRAAAAAAHHHHH!</color></size>
units.displayText: GRRRRAAAAAAHHHHH!

spans.text: GRRRRAAAAAAHHHHH!

units.rawText: Her howl is every bit as bestial as the Entropics surrounding her. In the darkness, her body warps and spasms, slowly twisting into the shape of a monster's.
units.displayText: Her howl is every bit as bestial as the Entropics surrounding her. In the darkness, her body warps and spasms, slowly twisting into the shape of a monster's.

spans.text: Her howl is every bit as bestial as the Entropics surrounding her. In the darkness, her body warps and spasms, slowly twisting into the shape of a monster's.

units.rawText: The fabric of space buckles and collapses beneath her wrath, as though it is going to cast her into an infinite abyss...
units.displayText: The fabric of space buckles and collapses beneath her wrath, as though it is going to cast her into an infinite abyss...

spans.text: The fabric of space buckles and collapses beneath her wrath, as though it is going to cast her into an infinite abyss...
PERSICARIA!!!

units.rawText: The girl who is a monster turns to look toward the sound.
units.displayText: The girl who is a monster turns to look toward the sound.

spans.text: The girl who is a monster turns to look toward the sound.

units.rawText: Far in the distance, at the source of that cry, is an ever-radiant star that will never go out. Its face is familiar. Its voice is familiar...
units.displayText: Far in the distance, at the source of that cry, is an ever-radiant star that will never go out. Its face is familiar. Its voice is familiar...

spans.text: Far in the distance, at the source of that cry, is an ever-radiant star that will never go out. Its face is familiar. Its voice is familiar...

options.rawText: Wake up, Persicaria. We haven't fulfilled our promise yet.
options.displayText: Wake up, Persicaria. We haven't fulfilled our promise yet.

spans.text: Wake up, Persicaria. We haven't fulfilled our promise yet.

units.rawText: <color=red>Professor... Professor...</color>
units.displayText: Professor... Professor...

spans.text: Professor... Professor...

units.rawText: <color=red>Aaaaaahhhhhh!</color>
units.displayText: Aaaaaahhhhhh!

spans.text: Aaaaaahhhhhh!

units.rawText: <color=red>I order you...</color>
units.displayText: I order you...

spans.text: I order you...

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>To... CEASE!</color></size>
units.displayText: To... CEASE!

spans.text: To... CEASE!

units.rawText: The words awaken what remains of her reason, and together, they seal the savagery of the Entropics into her neural cloud.
units.displayText: The words awaken what remains of her reason, and together, they seal the savagery of the Entropics into her neural cloud.

spans.text: The words awaken what remains of her reason, and together, they seal the savagery of the Entropics into her neural cloud.

units.rawText: The operands that were threatening to consume all just a moment ago gradually calm down and slowly gather under the Doll's control. They gently embrace her, waiting to be reborn inside her.
units.displayText: The operands that were threatening to consume all just a moment ago gradually calm down and slowly gather under the Doll's control. They gently embrace her, waiting to be reborn inside her.

spans.text: The operands that were threatening to consume all just a moment ago gradually calm down and slowly gather under the Doll's control. They gently embrace her, waiting to be reborn inside her.

units.rawText: Cracks open in her cocoon as crimson rays shoot out of it like arrows, instantly pulverizing the meteors that Eosphorus summoned.
units.displayText: Cracks open in her cocoon as crimson rays shoot out of it like arrows, instantly pulverizing the meteors that Eosphorus summoned.

spans.text: Cracks open in her cocoon as crimson rays shoot out of it like arrows, instantly pulverizing the meteors that Eosphorus summoned.

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: Has the power of Malkira within you awakened?
units.displayText: Has the power of Malkira within you awakened?

spans.text: Has the power of Malkira within you awakened?

units.rawText: Eosphorus gestures, ordering the surrounding Entropics to tear the Doll before him apart.
units.displayText: Eosphorus gestures, ordering the surrounding Entropics to tear the Doll before him apart.

spans.text: Eosphorus gestures, ordering the surrounding Entropics to tear the Doll before him apart.

units.rawText: Shhh.
units.displayText: Shhh.

spans.text: Shhh.

units.rawText: Do not torment these poor children anymore. Until just now, they were suffering because they were unable to escape your control.
units.displayText: Do not torment these poor children anymore. Until just now, they were suffering because they were unable to escape your control.

spans.text: Do not torment these poor children anymore. Until just now, they were suffering because they were unable to escape your control.

units.rawText: ...What is the meaning of this?
units.displayText: ...What is the meaning of this?

spans.text: ...What is the meaning of this?

units.rawText: It means... They will no longer do your bidding.
units.displayText: It means... They will no longer do your bidding.

spans.text: It means... They will no longer do your bidding.

units.rawText: Crimson rays break through the operand cocoon. The very air itself dances in joy as it rushes in to celebrate the rebirth and transfiguration of the newly-crowned Entropic queen.
units.displayText: Crimson rays break through the operand cocoon. The very air itself dances in joy as it rushes in to celebrate the rebirth and transfiguration of the newly-crowned Entropic queen.

spans.text: Crimson rays break through the operand cocoon. The very air itself dances in joy as it rushes in to celebrate the rebirth and transfiguration of the newly-crowned Entropic queen.

units.rawText: The Entropic swarm keens in delight, cheering the ascension of their new ruler.
units.displayText: The Entropic swarm keens in delight, cheering the ascension of their new ruler.

spans.text: The Entropic swarm keens in delight, cheering the ascension of their new ruler.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: The operands surrounding Persicaria finally dissolve into dust that fades on the wind. She emerges from the liquid Entropy and coldly regards the person before her.
units.displayText: The operands surrounding Persicaria finally dissolve into dust that fades on the wind. She emerges from the liquid Entropy and coldly regards the person before her.

spans.text: The operands surrounding Persicaria finally dissolve into dust that fades on the wind. She emerges from the liquid Entropy and coldly regards the person before her.

units.rawText: Return.
units.displayText: Return.

spans.text: Return.

units.rawText: Gwaaargh!
units.displayText: Gwaaargh!

spans.text: Gwaaargh!

units.rawText: The Entropic power that Eosphorus was freely using begins to revolt, as though sensing its queen's anger, and begins attempting to return to its rightful owner.
units.displayText: The Entropic power that Eosphorus was freely using begins to revolt, as though sensing its queen's anger, and begins attempting to return to its rightful owner.

spans.text: The Entropic power that Eosphorus was freely using begins to revolt, as though sensing its queen's anger, and begins attempting to return to its rightful owner.

units.rawText: Eosphorus is forced to subdivide his neural cloud further to forcibly subjugate the Entropic power inside him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus is forced to subdivide his neural cloud further to forcibly subjugate the Entropic power inside him.

spans.text: Eosphorus is forced to subdivide his neural cloud further to forcibly subjugate the Entropic power inside him.

units.rawText: ...I didn't think you would master it so soon.
units.displayText: ...I didn't think you would master it so soon.

spans.text: ...I didn't think you would master it so soon.

units.rawText: But so what? The more of it you accept, the closer you draw to the abyss.
units.displayText: But so what? The more of it you accept, the closer you draw to the abyss.

spans.text: But so what? The more of it you accept, the closer you draw to the abyss.

units.rawText: Then, you will be drawn back to Tartarus, and who will stop me?
units.displayText: Then, you will be drawn back to Tartarus, and who will stop me?

spans.text: Then, you will be drawn back to Tartarus, and who will stop me?

units.rawText: As a paragon of purity, you knelt to chaos to fulfill your selfish desires. When you accepted this bargain, you should have known that someday, you would have to pay for it.
units.displayText: As a paragon of purity, you knelt to chaos to fulfill your selfish desires. When you accepted this bargain, you should have known that someday, you would have to pay for it.

spans.text: As a paragon of purity, you knelt to chaos to fulfill your selfish desires. When you accepted this bargain, you should have known that someday, you would have to pay for it.

units.rawText: You should have chosen to set them aside, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: You should have chosen to set them aside, Eosphorus.

spans.text: You should have chosen to set them aside, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: <size=60>Now cease your wrongdoing!</size>

spans.text: Now cease your wrongdoing!

units.rawText: Crimson operands roar from the void, instantly piercing Eosphorus' shields and sinking deep into his body.

units.rawText: Uuuuurgh!
units.displayText: Uuuuurgh!

spans.text: Uuuuurgh!

units.rawText: All my thoughts suddenly come to a halt. My neural cloud begins to break down, converted into a data stream of interwoven 1s and 0s.

units.rawText: It flows through the void, along an invisible passage, carried by a flare of crimson light into another world.

spans.text: It flows through the void, along an invisible passage, carried by a flare of crimson light into another world.

units.rawText: This abnormal data plunges through the wounds in Eosphorus' body like a scarlet arrow, deep into Eosphorus' neural cloud. He tries to stop it, but it is already deep inside his Level III layer and he cannot extricate it by normal means.
